title: Compatibility of the defined finite horizontals
statement: Fix D,l,E,X,Q,a₀,b₀,T,e,M as in [def-coef-finite-adjunction-transition-data], with l different from the characteristic, a₀≤b₀, transition-compatible e, specified M, canonical tensor evaluation, and the scalar, origin, trace and Hom realization equations in the displayed Lean statement. Then for every input K and n≤m, HTransition(m,n) followed by finiteHorizontal(n,K) equals finiteHorizontal(m,K) followed by JTransition(m,n). There is no naturality conclusion and no separate étale trace conclusion. No isomorphism hypotheses on the horizontal maps are required.

source.place: Paragraph 2, finite mapping adjunctions and compatibility with reduction; original steps 1--9

proof.text: Uncurry the horizontal definition. The pairingEvaluation clause and the scalar and origin realization equations identify its transpose with the evaluated tower beta after the actual compact-support projection and trace. This retains the same supplied witnesses.

The actual compact-support projections form a cone by the total-limit projection construction and support_finite normalization. Canonical derived tensor evaluation respects the pointwise transitions: use flat-term K-flat representatives, then localization normalization. Naturality of beta and the hTrace and hHom equations give equality of the transposes. Naturality of the derived braiding and curry_natural_left/right give the displayed square.

proof_origin.place: Same finite mapping adjunction argument, with transition and input naturality separated.

theorem finiteAdjunctionSquare (hl : l ≠ D.p)
    (_hab : a₀ ≤ b₀)
    (_htransition : ∀ (m n : ℕ) (h : n ≤ m)
      (K : DerivedCategory (scalarReductionSource.{u, u} l E X)),
      (pbcTowerTransition (Spec (.of D.k))
        (completedIntegralCommRingSheafUnrestricted l E (Spec (.of D.k))) m n h).app
          (T.obj K) ≫ (e n).hom.app K =
        (e m).hom.app K ≫ compactSupportRestrictedTransition l E
          (finiteDualizingCompactification D X) m n h K)
    (_hM : M.IsSpecified l E D X Q a₀ b₀ T e)
    (_hTensor : ∀ n : ℕ, M.tensorEvaluation n = canonicalTensorEvaluation l E n)
    (_hscalar : ∀ (r : ℕ) (K : DerivedCategory (scalarReductionSource.{u, u} l E X)),
      (M.integralHom r).inv.app (op K) ≫ (M.finiteHom r).hom.app (op K) =
        scalarHom D l E X Q a₀ b₀ T e M r K)
    (eTrace : ∀ n : ℕ,
      (coefTraceEvaluation l E n).obj (coefTraceDualizingTower l E D X Q) ≅
        coefTraceFiniteValue l E D X n)
    (_hTrace : ∀ (m n : ℕ) (h : n ≤ m),
      (coefTraceTransition l E h).app (coefTraceDualizingTower l E D X Q) ≫
          (eTrace n).hom ≫ coefTraceFiniteCounit l E D X n ≫
            (coefTraceTargetIso l E D n).hom =
        (eTrace m).hom ≫ coefTraceFiniteCounit l E D X m ≫
          (coefTraceTargetIso l E D m).hom ≫
            (DerivedCategory.singleFunctor (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (coefTraceRing l E)) 0).map
              (coefTraceQuotientMap l E h))
    (_hOrigin : ∀ n : ℕ,
      (M.omegaEvaluation n).hom ≫ (M.omegaOrigin n).hom = (eTrace n).hom)
    (_hHom : ∀ (m n : ℕ) (h : n ≤ m)
      (K : DerivedCategory (scalarReductionSource.{u, u} l E X)),
      (coefTraceTransition l E h).app ((coefPairingHom l E X M.calculus Q).obj (op K)) ≫
          (M.integralHom n).hom.app (op K) =
        (M.integralHom m).hom.app (op K) ≫ HTransition D l E X hl h K) :
    ∀ (K : (CoefTower.inputs l E (X := X) a₀ b₀).FullSubcategory)
      (m n : ℕ) (h : n ≤ m),
      HTransition D l E X hl h K.obj ≫ finiteHorizontal D l E X Q a₀ b₀ T e M n K =
        finiteHorizontal D l E X Q a₀ b₀ T e M m K ≫
          JTransition D l E X T h K.obj
